predecessors.name: Sulayhid dynasty
predecessors.text: San'a and the San'a region, 'northern Yemen'

successors.name: Ayyubid Sultanate
successors.text: San'a and the San'a region, 'northern Yemen'

ledger.x: 1099: Hatim ibn al-Ghashim rules San'a after the death of the Sulayhid da'i Saba' bin Ahmad in 1098.
1174: the Ayyubids under Turan Shah capture San'a; Ali bin Hatim flees to a mountain fortress.
1174: the Hamdanid sultanate ends, expelled when the Ayyubids conquered Yemen.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundaries; 1139-50 and the Hamdan tribal lands were contested.
